Simulate cell-level and sample-level expression for the example data

Source: R/simulate.R
simulate_schint.Rd

Cell level: one cell type, `cells` per donor, a continuous cell state, donor and cell covariates. Sample level: `n_celltypes` cell types per donor. Each gene has its own variance architecture (`genes`).

Usage

simulate_schint(
  geno,
  genes = list(GENE_A = list(g = 0.2, gxc = 0.15, i = 0.1, cov = 0.05), GENE_B = list(g =
    0.25, gxc = 0, i = 0.1, cov = 0.05), GENE_C = list(g = 0, gxc = 0, i = 0.15, cov =
    0.05)),
  n_causal = 30,
  cells = c(15, 45),
  n_celltypes = 5,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

geno

Donors x SNPs dosage matrix (row names = donor IDs).

genes

Named list; each element is a list with `g` (main genetic variance), `gxc` (genotype x state / cell-type-specific genetic variance), `i` (donor variance), `cov` (covariate variance); the remainder is noise.

n_causal

Number of causal SNPs per gene.

cells

Range of cells per donor.

n_celltypes

Number of cell types for the sample-level data.

seed

Random seed.

Value

A list with `cell`, `sample` and `truth` (the generating variances).
